title: Book Three · Chapter 117: The Warm Pan
story:
The following Tuesday, Ronan posts his eighteenth letter to Leo.

The letter tells Leo about Kai's little room and the door against the table. Ronan also asks about the classes in Leo's city. He wants to hear about practical lessons as well as books.

At home, Mum has put a pan on the stove. She is making thin cakes with spring onions.

“Wash your hands,” she says. “You can turn the next one.”

Ronan leaves his bag by the door and washes. When he comes back, the edge of the first cake is brown.

Mum lifts it onto a plate. Then she pours the next round into the pan.

“Wait for the edge.”

Ronan watches it change. A few small holes appear across the top.

He slides the spatula under the cake. The cake folds in the middle.

“Not yet,” Mum says.

He lowers it and waits.

Dad comes in from work as the cake finally turns. One side lands flat. The other side stays folded.

“A cake with a pocket,” Dad says.

“For the onions,” Ronan answers.

Mum laughs and gives him a clean plate.

Ronan looks into the pan. The little piece at the fold is thicker than the rest.

“Is it cooked there?”

Mum lowers the heat. She presses the thick part gently with the spatula.

“Give that part a little more time.”

Dad takes his coat off and brings his knife and vegetables to the table. He begins to cut them. He watches Ronan look at the clock.

“Are we in a hurry?”

“No.”

“Then I can cut these smaller.”

Ronan waits beside the pan. When Mum lifts the thick edge again, the soft wet part has changed.

He tries again with the next cake. This time, he waits for the whole edge. He lifts it slowly and turns it without a fold.

Mum asks about the letter.

“I asked about lessons there,” Ronan says. “I don't know much about the choices.”

“What would you like to try?” Dad asks.

Ronan looks at the pan.

“Something practical. I liked explaining the room today.”

“Wasn't that last week?”

“Yes. Last week.”

Mum turns to look at him. “Your cake is today.”

He catches the edge before it gets too dark. Dad moves the finished plate away from the heat.

They finish the rest together. Mum puts her own bowl down and tastes one small piece.

“More salt next time.”

“I like this one,” Dad says.

“You like all the hot ones.”

He takes the folded cake from the bottom.

“This one keeps its heat inside.”

Ronan sits down with them. Outside, a cold wind moves beneath the kitchen door. Inside, Dad breaks the folded cake into three pieces.

Mum takes one. Ronan takes another and tastes the soft middle. A piece of onion sticks to his lip.

Dad points with his own piece. Mum gives Ronan the cloth before he can use his sleeve.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pan＝平底锅；spring onion＝小葱；spatula＝锅铲；fold＝折起、折痕。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第一次翻饼时发生什么？第二次怎样改变动作？
2. 第十八封信已经寄出了吗？他想了解Leo那边哪类信息？

## 读句子

**A few small holes appear across the top.**

拆开看：A few small holes / appear / across the top.

几个小孔／出现／在饼的上表面各处。
